newsitem.title: USA: First USA to redeem convertible preferred.
newsitem.headline: First USA to redeem convertible preferred.

text.p: First USA Inc said Friday it has elected to redeem all the outstanding shares of its 6-1/4 percent convertible preferred stock on May 20.
The company said it will deliver 1.67 shares of its common stock in exchange for each of the about 5.74 million outstanding shares of convertible preferred stock.
The company said cash will be paid in place of any fractional shares of common stock that would otherwise be issuable.
The company said holders of shares of convertible preferred stock on the close of business May 1 will be entitled to receive a quarterly dividend of $0.498 per share of preferred stock on May 20.
